lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

steps: On an isolated Debug emulator run LargeTextLayoutTest with Russian text, both themes, fontScale 1.0/1.3/2.0, density 420/540/620 and portrait/landscape effective widths 280/320/360/568 dp.
Check a compact ordinary two-row status panel at all display densities, no altitude/speed or empty footer; pass DOWN/MOVE/UP through collapsed menu slots and retain the visible add-button tap.

steps.When coordinates wrap, place short zoom/: check their own full text/actions, then check map controls separately after dismissal.

steps: Verify complete azimuth instructions, correction values, settings titles/summaries, layer/resource names, login labels and GPS status; reject ellipsis, hidden lines and overlapping controls.
Verify Close and all correction actions stay inside the fitted panel and receive touches at their transformed visible positions.

Open the real settings menu and General/Map/Location/Tracks sections; verify every adapter row and the actual account/login/project/underlay screens in both orientations, retaining their existing list/form scrolling.

Change real emulator font_scale to 2.0 and wm density to 620 together; invoke the real-window test with uiOrientation portrait and landscape, assert the actual Russian locale and orientation with the keyboard closed, no map-tool overlap, and reachable Close/Save/Cancel; inspect screenshots and run FormAppearanceTest. Restore emulator settings afterwards.
value.expected: All displayed labels remain readable and actions accessible; wrap and shorten first, fit remaining oversized components locally, restore natural sizes when room returns, and do not add scrolling to map panels. Physical OEM smoke remains separate.
